title: Kanban board
summary: Drag-and-drop Kanban board with multi-column cards, persistence on drop, and a richer card composing <Card>.
brief: Build a multi-column Kanban view for tasks/agents/issues. Columns are static (e.g. To do / Doing / Done); cards drag within and across columns. Persist the order on drop and reload it on mount.

steps.reason: Shared DnD primitives that Kanban + future sortable surfaces consume
Optional richer card UI inside KanbanCard

checklist.check: Card ids are stable strings (not array indices) — DnD breaks on reorder if ids shift.
Card ids are unique across ALL columns, not just within one column. Cross-column drag uses ids as the canonical identity.
onChange persists the new shape (PATCH backend, write IndexedDB, etc.) — otherwise a refresh wipes the reorder.
Server persistence is debounced or optimistic — synchronous fetch in onChange blocks the UI under fast drags.
Verified keyboard drag: Tab to a card, Space to pick up, arrows to move (within + across columns), Space to drop, Esc to cancel.
[Kanban] Avoid: Mutating the columns array in onChange — pass the returned array verbatim. Mutation breaks React's identity-based re-render and causes ghost cards
[Kanban] Avoid: Using array indices as cardIds — indices shift on reorder and break DnD. Use stable string IDs
[Kanban] Avoid: Forgetting that each KanbanCard id must be unique ACROSS columns, not just within one column — ids are the canonical identity for cross-column drag
[Kanban] Avoid: Wrapping the whole Kanban in an extra DndContext — Kanban already provides one. Nested contexts confuse dnd-kit's collision detection

[Kanban] A11y: @dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor is wired by default — Tab to focus a card, Space/Enter to pick up, arrow keys to move (within or across columns), Space/Enter to drop, Escape to cancel. Live-region announcements describe drag state for screen readers. The drag-handle visual is the entire card; consumers can override the cursor via className.
[DnD] Avoid: Forgetting that each item needs a stable `id` field — re-using array index as id breaks DnD on reorder because the indices shift
[DnD] Avoid: Mutating the items array in onChange instead of replacing it — use the returned array verbatim

[DnD] Avoid: Calling useSortableItem outside a SortableContext — the hook will throw or no-op silently. SortableList provides one automatically; manual DndProvider users must wrap with <SortableContext items={ids} strategy={...}>
[DnD] Avoid: Spreading `listeners` on a separate handle without keeping `attributes` on the wrapper — the wrapper needs ARIA wiring even if the handle is the only drag target

[DnD] A11y: @dnd-kit ships KeyboardSensor by default — Tab to focus a draggable, Space/Enter to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space/Enter to drop, Escape to cancel. Live-region announcements are built in. The PointerSensor uses a 4px activation distance so accidental clicks don't trigger drag.
[Card] Avoid: Nesting cards
[Card] Avoid: Using Card when a simple div with border would suffice
[Card] Avoid: Forgetting CardContent padding when placing forms inside
[Card] A11y: Card is a div by default. Add role='region' and aria-labelledby (pointing to CardTitle's id) for landmark cards. CardTitle renders h3 — ensure heading hierarchy is correct on the page.
[Badge] Avoid: Using destructive variant for non-error states
[Badge] Avoid: Badge text too long
[Badge] A11y: Purely decorative by default. Add role='status' for dynamic status badges.
[Avatar] Avoid: Missing alt text on AvatarImage
[Avatar] Avoid: No AvatarFallback — shows nothing when image is missing or errors
[Avatar] Avoid: Omitting delayMs on AvatarFallback causes flicker for fast-loading images
[Avatar] Avoid: Using for non-circular images (override rounded-full if needed)
[Avatar] A11y: AvatarImage requires alt text. AvatarFallback renders initials or an icon — ensure the visible text is meaningful.
[Button] Avoid: Nesting interactive elements inside asChild button
[Button] Avoid: Using — breaks middle-click, cmd-click, and right-click → 'open in new tab', and skips the browser history entry
[Button] Avoid: Using <Button variant='destructive'> for recoverable actions like 'Reset filters' — reserve destructive for delete/archive/leave; use 'secondary' or 'ghost' for resets
[Button] Avoid: Using <Button size='icon'> without an aria-label — screen readers have nothing to announce; always pair icon-only buttons with aria-label or visible text
[Button] A11y: Automatically handles focus ring, disabled state, and aria attributes. Icon-only buttons MUST have aria-label. Loading state automatically sets disabled.
